definitions: An apparatus for raising and lowering people or things, especially a cage or platform in a vertical shaft.
A ride in a vehicle given to someone who is walking.
A device for raising a vehicle off the ground for maintenance.
A feeling of increased happiness or confidence.
examples: Take the lifts to the fifth floor.
Can I get a lift to the station?
The mechanic put the car on the lifts.
The good news gave her a real lift.
